# Node.js Mobile notice

Novi Studio bundles the Android Node.js Mobile shared library supplied by the project owner as:

- Node.js Mobile: `18.20.4`
- Android ABIs: `arm64-v8a`, `armeabi-v7a`, `x86_64`
- Native library: `libnode.so`

The bundled headers and native library retain their upstream licensing and copyright notices.
The upstream Node.js Mobile project is distributed under the MIT license and incorporates the Node.js project and other third-party components with their respective notices.

https://github.com/nodejs-mobile/nodejs-mobile
